resource_preflight.installed_transformers: 4.21.1 (does not implement the selected DINOv2/SigLIP classes)
resource_preflight.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU, 8188 MiB
resource_preflight.environment_policy: install transformers==4.57.1, tokenizers==0.22.1, and safetensors==0.6.2 under ignored .cache/stage_e_python only; do not modify the project .venv
resource_preflight.third_family: disabled because no third checkpoint or loader is locally available and adding another stack is not justified

common_input.source: same upright unmodified 128x128 uint8 natural RGB

DINOv2-S14.preprocessing: convert RGB; bicubic resize shortest edge 256; center crop 224x224; rescale 1/255; ImageNet mean/std
DINOv2-S14.token_source: final Dinov2Model.last_hidden_state[:,1:,:] after model final layer norm; exclude CLS

SigLIP-B16-224.architecture: SiglipVisionModel from the frozen SiglipModel checkpoint, ViT-B/16, hidden 768
SigLIP-B16-224.preprocessing: convert RGB; bicubic resize directly to 224x224; rescale 1/255; mean/std 0.5; no crop
SigLIP-B16-224.token_source: final SiglipVisionModel.last_hidden_state containing patch tokens only; no CLS token

freeze.persist: float16 offline spatial token caches; reader arithmetic float32
